title: Real Tesla looks
items: Every car rebuilt to look like the real Tesla, to its real length, width, height and wheelbase: smooth bodies with no grilles, black glass roofs, flush door handles and mirrors.
The Roadster is now the second-generation Tesla Roadster: raised front wings, a black glass canopy, wide rear haunches and a ducktail for the active wing.

Model 3 with slim swept headlamps and C-shaped tail lamps; Model Y with light bars across the nose and tail; Model S with bright window trim; Model X with its panoramic windscreen and falcon-wing roof seam; Cybercab with light bars and covered wheels.
The Cybertruck in flat stainless panels with its straight apex roofline, nose and tailgate light bars and dark arch flares.
The Semi with a bullet-train windscreen, a nose light bar, cab extenders, skirts over the batteries and the fifth wheel over its tandem axles.
Glass is dark tinted by default (gold is still in the Garage).

title: Eight Teslas, pit stops and a commentator
items: An all-Tesla line-up: Roadster, Model 3, Model X, Model S, Model Y, Cybertruck, Cybercab and Semi, each with its own body and handling. The Model 3, X and S are earned in the career; the Model Y, Cybertruck, Cybercab and Semi are free from the start.
Real pit stops: a pit lane with a speed limiter, a box for every car and a crew that fits fresh tyres and fixes the car. Tyres now wear out, and the bots pit too.
A race commentator calls overtakes, crashes, stunts, pit stops and the finish, with captions and a cheering crowd. Turn it to captions only or off in Settings.
Sharper steering and stronger brakes, and a much faster tow Roadster.
Fun Mode: seven ramps and more rings of fire that sway and pulse, and the flames now set your car alight.
Advertising boards along the barriers and flags on the grandstand.

title: Fun Mode and the Garage
items: Fun Mode: red ramps with neon edges, rings of fire and item boxes.
The Garage: paint, rim colours, liveries, wings and tyres for your car.
Version numbers: the home screen shows the version you're playing, and this list shows what changed in each one.

title: Crashes and the tow Roadster
items: Crash damage: hard hits dent the car.
A flying tow Roadster hooks on to a crashed car and carries it back to the track.

title: Smoother, sharper, faster loading
items: Steer in the air: while you jump or hover, steering turns the car and the way it is flying, even with an empty tank.
Faster loading, with tips and this list while the game starts.
Party QR codes work again: scan one to join the party.
A sharper picture, no more freezing when the time of day changes, and the Graphics setting works.

title: Road Thruster controls
items: Space jumps, hold it to hover, and Q / E fire the side thrusters.

title: Careers
items: Championships, licenses and race weekends, with the 0x1.5, 0x2.5 and 0x3.5 cars to earn.
Pick your car class before a session.

title: Home screen and rivals
items: A home screen with every mode, race setup, settings and a pause menu.
Eleven rivals to race, with five difficulties and any number of laps.
Tyres warm up as you drive and cool down in the air.
iPad mode: touch pedals, a steering slider and tilt steering.

title: Parties
items: Parties: race your friends with a join code or a QR code.

title: Racing
items: AI rivals to race, with name tags and jets you can hear.
The showroom: look around the car on a turntable.

title: Thrusters
items: Rocket boost and air canisters on the track.

title: First drive
items: The electric Roadster, the circuit, chase cameras and electric motor sound.
